verifier.evidence: HTTP 200. 'Gelusil MPS Mint Chewable Tablet', Pfizer Ltd; activated dimethicone + dried aluminium hydroxide + magnesium hydroxide + magnesium aluminium silicate.
verifier.notes: MEDIUM: every pharmacy brands the tablet 'Gelusil MPS' while our record is plain 'Gelusil'. Accepted on form and composition per the ambiguity rule -- MPS chewable is the ONLY tablet presentation of Gelusil, and the antacid composition matches -- but the brand string is not identical. Gelusil Original/Xtra Cool/Raft liquids and Gelusil Plus were rejected as different products or forms.
